name: Red Hand
text: Red Hand is the English sense of the Irish lám derg. MacKillop routes the entry to the article on Labraid Lámderg, whose name carries the red-hand epithet. In that hero's record, the epithet marks a Fianna champion, son of Bolg, who travels overseas with Oscar.
